title: Redis Context Map Metadata
description: Schema for context map (interactive flow diagram) metadata in Redis documentation

id.description: Unique identifier for the context map

scope.description: Category or domain this diagram applies to (e.g., 'context-engine')

nodes.description: Object containing all diagram nodes, keyed by ID

type.description: Shape used to render this node

col.description: Zero-based column position on the layout grid

row.description: Zero-based row position on the layout grid

description.description: Text shown in the detail panel when this node is selected

docsUrl.description: Optional site-relative link shown in the detail panel, labeled "Read more". Rendered after any links in the links object.

links.description: Optional set of labeled site-relative links shown in the detail panel, keyed by ID, rendered in order before docsUrl

label.description: Link text shown in the detail panel

edges.description: Object containing all diagram edges, keyed by ID

kind.description: How the edge is drawn: a direct line, a labeled branch, or a dashed loopback routed around the diagram

route.description: For a loopback edge, which side of the diagram the dashed curve routes around. Defaults to bottom.

label.description: Optional text shown alongside the edge

path.description: Optional comma-separated list of top-level path IDs this edge belongs to, for the scenario buttons (e.g. "memory,context"). Edges without a path are treated as shared by every path.

paths.description: Object containing named scenarios that highlight a subset of edges/nodes when selected, keyed by ID

label.description: Text shown on the scenario button

description.description: Text shown in the detail panel when this scenario is selected
